answers.valueEn: The car has undergone full paint oxidation treatment; oxidation signs on the roof, trunk, hood, and both outer pillars. Salt deposits from the plastic water elbow on the timing cover. Undercarriage hit causing a break in the floor shield and simple body scratches. Tear in the front right door upholstery. Signs of removal on the catalytic converter bolts. Oil leak from the engine drain plug, rear crankshaft oil seal, and turbo connection. Break in the torpedo cowl plastic. Needs wheel alignment after suspension work.
